permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Reaches your own Gloz backend, which fetches your messages and sends the replies you approve.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Hears what you say while you hold the touchpad, to change a reply or to say send.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Only Navigation (directions) and the Dashboard (local weather) use your position, and only while they are open. Messages never need it.
